chunks: Ishaq ibn Ammar asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the least degree of extravagance, so he said:
"That you use your garment of preservation in a degrading manner, that you pour away the excess of the vessel, and that you throw the date pits like this and like that."

key_terms.تُهَرِيقُهُ: you pour it out or spill it
key_terms.ثَوْبُ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.صَوْنِكَ: your preservation, dignity, or protected state

ai.seo_question: What is the least form of extravagance according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies even small, everyday forms of extravagance and wastefulness. It teaches care in using one’s possessions properly and avoiding needless disposal of usable things.
